root_acceptance.reason: Root accepted the byte-accurate local save-interop implementation after the replacement aggregate passed. KRT certification and release readiness remain withheld because required worker terminals and diff-bound certificates are absent, interactive stock-mGBA/Lua conformance was not run, and the recorded production, gameplay-integrity, provenance, and process-lifecycle blockers remain open.

character_save.container: Pokecrossroads Flash1M with two rotating 15-sector slots and an optional 16-byte mGBA RTC trailer
character_save.selection: ROM-equivalent wrap-aware newest-slot selection; invalid selected state fails closed rather than silently rolling back
character_save.bootstrap: The parser accepts only exact erased flash at revision zero, but the launcher does not fabricate character.sav; first boot starts without the file until the ROM creates the canonical save.

regional_identity_registry.coverage_boundary: All 854 Hoenn trainer IDs are assigned; Kanto and Johto trainer, Fly-point, and event coverage outside the recorded exemplars remains fail-closed when unassigned.

progress_semantics: Logical RegionalProgress values are region-qualified for Hoenn, Kanto, Johto, and Sevii.
CSP1 stores four ordered badge/story records plus separate trainer, gym, Fly-point, and event ordinal bitsets.
Every persisted ordinal and every regional badge bit must be assigned by the pinned registry; unused capacity is invalid progress.
Migration-ambiguous saves remain available offline but are rejected at online upload, finalize, and restore boundaries.

The first snapshot binds later revisions to the selected SaveBlock2 lineage and generation 1; normal revisions require exact wrapping generation advancement, while a verified historical restore may reset the head generation.
accepted_contract.service_boundary: The local server enforces lease and parent-revision fences, byte quotas including active staging, immutable object ownership, and retryable orphan cleanup. Production adapters and background garbage collection are not part of this acceptance.
accepted_contract.launcher_boundary: Revision-zero launch leaves character.sav absent for the ROM to create. Exact argv binding, shell-free spawning, observed staged-file replacement rejection, ordinary concurrent-session isolation, marker retention, and bounded forced kill/reap are locally tested. Fresh per-launch directories, DELETE_ON_CLOSE where supported, and final identity checks do not make safe standard-library name-based cleanup atomic against a hostile same-user replacement during the pre-open interval. Atomic Windows Job Object attachment, a vendor-binary digest, an authenticated bounded graceful-shutdown exchange, and audited handle-based cleanup remain outside this acceptance.

protocol_supersession.decision: SAVE_DATA_UPDATED now carries exactly one little-endian u32 save_generation while CHECKPOINT_READY and CHECKPOINT_GRANTED remain empty; bridge ABI and protocol version stay at 1.
consumer_evidence: src/coop/net_bridge.c::TrySendPendingSaveDataUpdated serializes the live generation into four little-endian bytes.
coop/crates/coop-sidecar/src/server.rs decodes exactly four bytes and forwards save_generation on the typed control event.
coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs correlates epoch, ready sequence, save sequence, payload generation, and parsed character.sav generation before upload.
coop/crates/coop-launcher/tests/phase2_smoke.rs drives the generation-one frame and byte-accurate character.sav through the real local lifecycle.
